data.value: The archive is an ordinary file, so dropping it in OneDrive, Google Drive or Dropbox is how you hand a workspace to a colleague. It never contains your sign-in tokens, provider API keys or connector credentials — those stay in this Mac's keychain. What it must never contain is TechieDesk's live data folder itself: that holds an open database, and sync clients corrupt it.

data.name: QdrantDaemonPlainTcpWarning
data.value: This endpoint is plain, unauthenticated TCP. A Docker daemon is effectively root on its host, so anyone who can reach this address can take full control of that machine. Use a TLS-protected endpoint (tcps://) unless you fully trust the network path.
data.comment: Docker daemon security warning (REQ-UI-055). tcps:// is a URI scheme and stays in Latin script.

data.name: QdrantDaemonTlsVerificationDisabledWarning
data.value: TLS certificate verification is disabled for this endpoint. The channel is encrypted but TechieDesk cannot prove it is talking to the intended daemon, so the connection can be intercepted. Re-enable verification and trust the daemon's CA instead.
data.comment: Docker daemon security warning (REQ-UI-055).

data.name: QdrantDaemonEndpointUnsupportedScheme

data.name: MaintenanceItemCompacted
data.comment: Per-item result for one compacted database: the size before and after. {0} and {1} are byte sizes. Written as a sentence rather than as '{0} → {1}', because a resource whose whole value is punctuation is exactly what LocalizationTests.EveryHindiStringIsWrittenInDevanagari rejects, correctly (REQ-UI-056).

data.name: MaintenanceDetailOneDatabase
data.comment: One segment of the maintenance run's summary line, singular. {0} is a count (REQ-UI-056).

data.name: MaintenanceDetailReclaimed

data.value: The run does not say which connector to read.
data.comment: Refusal when a connector payload names no connector (REQ-UI-056).

data.name: ConnectorPayloadNoConnectorType
data.value: The run does not say what kind of connector to read.
data.comment: Refusal when a connector payload names no connector type (REQ-UI-056).

data.name: ConnectorPayloadItemLimitTooLow
data.value: The item limit must be at least 1, otherwise the run can never fetch anything.

data.value: The per-item size limit must be greater than zero.
data.comment: Refusal when a connector payload's per-item size cap is zero or negative (REQ-UI-056).

data.name: ConnectorNoTypesInstalled
data.value: No connector types are installed in this build of TechieDesk.
data.comment: Refusal from the placeholder resolver used by a build that ships no connectors (REQ-UI-056).

data.name: ConnectorSettingsUnknownType
data.value: '{0}' is not a kind of connector this build can run.
data.comment: Refusal when a stored connector type is not one this build knows. {0} is the stored type key, wire vocabulary, never translated (REQ-UI-056).

data.name: ConnectorNoLongerSaved
data.value: The connector '{0}' is no longer saved, so there is nothing to read.
data.comment: Run failure when the connector a schedule names has been deleted. {0} is the connector's name (REQ-UI-056).

data.name: ConnectorNoLongerSavedAddAgain
data.value: The connector '{0}' is no longer saved, so there is nothing to read. Add it again on the connectors screen.
data.comment: The same refusal shown at save time, where the operator can act on it. {0} is the connector's name (REQ-UI-056).

data.name: ConnectorNoLongerSavedShort
data.value: That connector is no longer saved.
data.comment: Result of testing a connector that has since been deleted (REQ-UI-056).

data.name: ConnectorTypeMismatch
data.value: This run expects a {0} connector, but '{1}' is a {2} connector.
data.comment: Refusal when a schedule's stored connector type no longer matches the saved connector. {0} and {2} are wire type keys, {1} is the connector's name (REQ-UI-056).

data.name: ConnectorCredentialUnreadable
data.value: The saved access token for '{0}' could not be read from this machine's credential store. Re-enter the token on the connector and run it again.
data.comment: Run failure when a connector claims a credential the OS store no longer holds. {0} is the connector's name (REQ-UI-056).

data.name: ConnectorRegistrationNeedsName
data.value: The connector needs a name, so it can be told apart from the others.
data.comment: Refusal when a connector is saved with no display name (REQ-UI-056).

data.name: ConnectorNameAlreadyTaken
data.value: A connector called '{0}' already exists — names have to be unique, so give this one a different name.
data.comment: Refusal when a connector's name collides with another. {0} is the name the operator typed (REQ-UI-056).

data.name: ConnectorSettingsMailNeedsSource
data.value: A mail connector needs either an IMAP server or the path to a local .mbox file.
data.comment: Refusal when a mail connector names neither a server nor an archive (REQ-UI-056).

data.name: ConnectorSettingsMailBothSources
data.value: This connector names both an IMAP server and an .mbox file. Choose one — they are different mailboxes, and reading both under one connector would merge two sources into one set of citations.
data.comment: Refusal when a mail connector names both a server and an archive (REQ-UI-056).

data.name: ConnectorSettingsMboxNotFullPath
data.value: '{0}' is not a full path to an .mbox file.
data.comment: Refusal when a mailbox archive path is relative. {0} is the path as typed, never translated (REQ-UI-056).

data.name: ConnectorSettingsMailNeedsUsername
data.value: A mail connector needs the account name to sign in with, usually the address.
data.comment: Refusal when an IMAP connector has no account name (REQ-UI-056).

data.name: ConnectorSettingsMailCleartextPort
data.value: Port {0} is a cleartext mail port, and this connector refuses it: your mailbox password and every message would cross the network unencrypted. Use 993, the implicit-TLS IMAP port.
data.comment: Refusal when a mail connector is pointed at a cleartext port. {0} is the port number (REQ-UI-056).

data.name: ConnectorSettingsMailCleartextScheme
data.value: 'imap://' is the cleartext scheme and is refused. Enter the host name on its own — the connection is always TLS.
data.comment: Refusal when a mail host is entered with the cleartext URL scheme (REQ-UI-056).

data.name: ConnectorSettingsRepositoryNeedsPath
data.value: A repository connector needs a project path, for example 'owner/repository'.
data.comment: Refusal when a repository connector has no project path. The example is wire vocabulary and stays in Latin script (REQ-UI-056).

data.name: ConnectorSettingsRepositoryPathNotOwnerRepo
data.value: '{0}' is not a project path; it needs an owner or group, for example 'owner/repository'.
data.comment: Refusal when a repository project path has no owner segment. {0} is the path as typed (REQ-UI-056).

data.name: ConnectorSettingsApiUrlNotAbsolute
data.value: The API base URL must be an absolute http or https address.
data.comment: Refusal for a malformed repository API base URL. A whole key per URL role, because the role is a noun the sentence is built around (REQ-UI-056).

data.name: ConnectorSettingsWebUrlNotAbsolute
data.value: The web base URL must be an absolute http or https address.
data.comment: Refusal for a malformed repository web base URL (REQ-UI-056).

data.name: ConnectorSettingsSiteUrlNotAbsolute
data.value: The site URL must be an absolute http or https address.
data.comment: Refusal for a malformed Confluence site URL (REQ-UI-056).

data.name: ConnectorSettingsUrlPrivateNetwork
data.value: '{0}' is on a private network. Turn on 'allow this connector to reach my own network' if that is deliberate — it lets this connector send its credential to an address inside your network.
data.comment: Refusal when a connector URL points at a private-network host without the opt-in. {0} is the host name, never translated (REQ-UI-056).

data.name: ConnectorSettingsConfluenceNeedsSiteUrl
data.value: A Confluence connector needs a site URL, for example 'https://acme.atlassian.net/wiki'.
data.comment: Refusal when a Confluence connector has no site URL. The example URL is wire vocabulary (REQ-UI-056).

data.name: ConnectorSettingsConfluenceNeedsOneOf
data.value: A Confluence connector needs exactly one of a space key or a page id — a space is a different walk from a page tree.
data.comment: Refusal when a Confluence connector names both a space and a page, or neither (REQ-UI-056).

data.name: SupportAttachmentLimitsSummary
data.value: PNG, JPG, PDF, LOG · 10 MB each
data.comment: Support: the attachment limits shown beside the drop zone and quoted back in a type refusal. The four format tokens are file-type names and stay in Latin script in every language (REQ-UI-055 / REQ-UI-047).

data.name: SupportAttachmentRejectedNoName
data.value: That file can't be attached — it has no file name.
data.comment: Support: a dropped or pasted payload arrived with no file name (REQ-UI-055 / REQ-UI-047).

data.name: SupportAttachmentRejectedType
data.comment: Support: the file's type is outside the allowlist. {0} is the file name, {1} the translated limits summary (REQ-UI-055 / REQ-UI-047).

data.name: SupportAttachmentRejectedEmpty
data.value: "{0}" can't be attached — the file is empty.
data.comment: Support: a zero-byte attachment. {0} is the file name (REQ-UI-055 / REQ-UI-047).

data.name: SupportAttachmentRejectedTooLarge
data.comment: Support: the declared size is over the cap. {0} is the file name, {1} its size, {2} the cap (REQ-UI-055 / REQ-UI-047).

data.name: SupportAttachmentRejectedOverLimit
data.value: "{0}" is larger than the {1} attachment limit.
data.comment: Support: the bytes streaming in passed the cap, so the partial file was deleted. {0} is the file name, {1} the cap (REQ-UI-055 / REQ-UI-047).

data.name: SupportAttachmentRejectedOutsideRoot
data.value: That attachment can't be staged — its name resolves outside the support attachments folder.
data.comment: Support: the sanitised path escaped the attachments root (REQ-UI-055 / REQ-UI-047).

data.name: ChatExportFailedDetail
data.comment: Chat: the save panel itself threw. {0} is the underlying error, never translated (REQ-UI-055 / REQ-FN-010).

data.name: ChatExportNotSaved
data.value: The export could not be saved.
data.comment: Chat: the platform save service reported a failure with no reason of its own (REQ-UI-055 / REQ-FN-010).

data.name: ChatExportNoFileWritten
data.value: The export reported success but no file was written.
data.comment: Chat: a save service claimed success and produced nothing — the defect REQ-FN-010 exists for (REQ-UI-055).

data.name: ChatExportEmptyFile
data.value: The export produced an empty file.
data.comment: Chat: the file exists but is zero bytes (REQ-UI-055 / REQ-FN-010).

data.name: ChatExportSaved
data.comment: Chat: the confirmed export toast. {0} is the thread title, {1} the format name (Markdown/JSON, never translated), {2} the file path (REQ-UI-055 / REQ-FN-010).

data.name: AgentsInvalidHandle
data.value: A handle must be 1–32 letters, digits or hyphens, for example @analyst.
data.comment: Workspace agents: the handle typed in the agent editor does not match the allowed shape. The example handle stays in Latin script — it is a real handle (REQ-UI-055 / REQ-UI-045).

data.name: AgentsDisplayNameRequired
data.value: An agent needs a display name.
data.comment: Workspace agents: the display-name field was left empty in the agent editor (REQ-UI-055 / REQ-UI-045).

data.name: AgentsHandleAlreadyUsed
data.value: @{0} is already used by "{1}" in this workspace.
data.comment: Workspace agents: a handle collision caught before the database constraint. {0} is the handle, {1} the clashing agent's display name — both user data, never translated (REQ-UI-055 / REQ-UI-045).

data.name: AgentsBuiltInNotDeletable
data.value: The built-in @agent cannot be deleted. Reset it to its defaults instead.
data.comment: Workspace agents: delete was attempted on the built-in agent. @agent is the literal handle and stays in Latin script (REQ-UI-055 / REQ-UI-045).

data.name: DictationPermissionDenied
data.value: Microphone or speech access was refused. Grant it in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Microphone (and Speech Recognition), then try again.
data.comment: Chat composer: macOS refused microphone or speech-recognition access. The System Settings pane names stay in Latin script — that is what the OS shows, and a translated path name would send the user looking for a pane that does not exist (REQ-UI-055 / REQ-UI-035).

data.name: FlowsRunNeedsLlmProvider
data.value: This flow has a step that calls a model and no LLM provider is configured, so nothing was run. Configure a model in LLM settings first.
data.comment: Workspace flows: the run was refused because a model-calling node has no provider. LLM stays in Latin script as a protocol noun (REQ-UI-055 / REQ-RAG-024).
